verdict.rationale: Firebase's core databases (Firestore, Realtime Database) are NoSQL and are not accessed via a standard connection string; however, docs mention Firestore Enterprise edition offers a MongoDB-compatible API letting developers use existing MongoDB drivers/tools, and a passing reference to 'Firebase SQL Connect' in MCP docs hints at some SQL-style connectivity. missing for 10: no documentation of an actual connection-string format, no mention of standard ORMs (e.g., Prisma, SQLAlchemy) working against Firebase, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that MongoDB or SQL drivers connect seamlessly.
